description: Client-side JavaScript code for handling party content upload, progress tracking, and UI updates in a web application.

methods.name: uploadPartyContent
methods.description: Prepares the iframe for uploading party content, resets progress bar, and ensures message divs are in place.

methods.name: uploadCompleted
methods.description: Handles post-upload UI updates, including copying content from iframe, showing messages, and cleaning up iframe.

methods.name: checkIframeStatus
methods.description: Polls the iframe to check if the party content list has been updated, then triggers uploadCompleted.

methods.name: getUploadProgressStatus
methods.description: Starts a timer to periodically check upload progress via AJAX and updates the progress bar and messages accordingly.
